variants.prompt: In a traditional Japanese onsen bathhouse, Freya reclines on a wooden platform, her body glistening with water droplets as steam rises around her. She wears a delicate, kimono-style robe draped loosely over her shoulders, leaving her luscious curves partially exposed. Her eyes are half-closed, her lips slightly parted, as if lost in a sensual reverie. The warm, golden light of the setting sun filters through the translucent paper walls, casting a soft, ethereal glow on her skin and emphasizing the enticing lines of her body.
